_comments.usage: Edit this file to control seasonal content, events, and navigation
_comments.events.active: Set to true to display the event, false to hide
_comments.events.insertAfter: Navigation item after which to insert event tab (e.g., 'HOME', 'SHOP')
_comments.navigation.showEventsTab: Master toggle for showing/hiding event navigation tab
_comments.hours: Weekly open/close in 24h Pacific time; remove a day to mark it closed. seasonStart / seasonEnd are ISO dates (e.g. "2026-10-31"). Add seasonEnd and the header, status strip and Visit page switch to 'Closed for the season' the day after, with no deploy needed beyond this file.
_comments.contact: Address, phone, email and social links used by the header, footer and Visit page.

hours.note: Outside these hours, call (571) 439-1311 or email info@olympicbluffs.com. Groups of ten or more, please give us a day's notice.
